job.title: Clinical Marketing Specialist @ nuclivision (Ghent, Flemish Region, Belgium)
job.description:
‍
**About Nuclivision**
Nuclivision is a medical imaging software startup based in Ghent, Belgium, founded in 2022. We develop AI-driven software for nuclear medicine, with the aim of enhancing safety, reducing costs and improving efficiency for clinicians and patients. Our flagship, NUCLARITY, is a CE-marked (Class IIa medical device) deep learning platform for PET image enhancement. It is used in clinical practice in Belgium and Germany and other centers throughout Europe, and we are building towards other markets and future products.
  
  
**The role**
In 2026 we laid the marketing foundation: positioning, key messages, a marketing playbook, a website, a CRM and an active LinkedIn presence. In 2027 we are growing further by introducing a new product and entering new markets. You take operational marketing in your hands and help us sharpen it along the way.
  
  
You will work on a Software as a Medical Device (SaMD) used in clinical practice and backed by clinical evidence, for a small, specialised audience that values substance over noise. In a team of around 15, what you propose gets looked at quickly, and what we agree on ships.
  
  
**What You Will Do**

* You make customers the hero. Based on customer interviews, write the case study, publish it on the website and promote it on LinkedIn, with video as an option. You also prepare and promote webinars with a key opinion leader.
* You are a storyteller with an eye for design. You write white papers and case studies based on our scientific input, check every claim against its source, and make complex medtech topics readable and worth sharing. Get the content out in a nice package and adjust distribution where needed.
* You keep LinkedIn and the newsletter alive and kicking. A monthly editorial calendar agreed in advance, a fixed rhythm of 2 to 3 posts per week and at least one newsletter per quarter, built from the cases and papers you write and the exciting news we need to share. You know what gets engagement and when to stay quiet.
* You make the website and HubSpot work harder. Website content in Webflow with our developer. Contact management, tagging, inbound leads, and setting up and evaluating campaigns in HubSpot.
* You enjoy the good kind of chaos called events. One major European congress and five to ten smaller national events per year, with the next larger one around April. You support the peaks: materials, booth content and design, preparation and follow-up.
* You do not just execute, you steer. You look at how our channels perform (LinkedIn, newsletters, website, webinars) and which feedback we get, adjust where needed, and come up with proposals: a LinkedIn campaign, other channels to explore, a restructured website.

**What We Are Looking For**

* 2 to 4 years of marketing or communications experience in medtech, healthcare, life sciences or another regulated sector, or a clinical or scientific background (for example nuclear medicine, radiology, biomedical engineering) combined with marketing experience
* You can read clinical or scientific papers and turn the data into clear messages for a specialist audience without losing the science, and you check claims against their source
* Excellent written English, Dutch and other EU languages are a plus
* Hands-on experience with HubSpot, Webflow and Canva, or you pick them up fast; basic SEO
* Event experience, from booth content to coordination
* Structured, reliable and calm when a congress is around the corner
* Comfortable with approval workflows and approved claims
* A plus: knowledge of PET or SPECT, or of AI in healthcare

**What We Offer**

* A full-time role in Ghent (HQ) or hybrid
* A foundation to build on: positioning, playbook, website, CRM and customer content are in place, so you start producing and improving instead of starting from scratch
* Real influence in a small team of around 15, with direct access to our commercial and regulatory colleagues
* A team with character: shared lunches with the best “préparé” in town, carrot cake treats prepared by those who forgot to lock their computer, a pot luck of exotic foods, discussions on where to find the best surf waves,…
* Variety you will remember: one week a hospital visit to see the product at work, the next a congress booth or a video shoot with the customers whose stories you tell
* Growth with the company as we launch new products and enter new markets
* A structured start as soon as available, with sales meetings, a product demo, training on claims and the IFU, and where possible a customer visit

Send your CV, a short cover letter and 2 to 3 examples of your work (ideally medtech or healthcare) when applying using the form below.

job.title: Digital Product Manager, AI & Data Automation - Customer Insight & Market Research @ CNH (Zedelgem, Flemish Region, Belgium)
job.description:
**About Us**
At CNH, we're driven by a clear purpose:
**we serve and advance the people who feed and build a growing world.**
As a global leader in agriculture and construction, we create the equipment, technology, and solutions that help our customers work more productively and sustainably. Our success starts with our people, and we foster a collaborative culture where innovation thrives and every employee has the opportunity to grow.
  
  
**Grow a Career. Build a Future.**
If you're ready to make an impact and build a career with purpose, there's a place for you at CNH.
  
  
**Job Purpose**
The Digital Product Manager, AI & Data Automation operates within the Customer Insights & Market Research team. The function provides robust, structured and decision-ready customer, dealer and market evidence to support product development, go-to-market and business decisions.
  
  
Your primary objective is to define, prioritize, develop and drive adoption of the AI, data and automation product portfolio for Customer Insights & Market Research. You will transform fragmented research information into structured, traceable, searchable and reusable insight assets, while coordinating business stakeholders, Digital, Data Governance, IT and external technology partners.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Define and maintain the digital product vision, strategy and roadmap for AI, data and workflow automation across Customer Insights & Market Research (development budget approximately of 600K$ USD)
* Collect, structure and prioritize needs from the central CI&MR team, Product Research, Dealer Research and Regional Research Centers.
* Translate user and business needs into use cases, epics, features, user stories, acceptance criteria and measurable outcomes.
* Playing the role of PM following AGILE principles: Manage the AI and automation backlog and engage in agile ceremonies, including planning, reviews, demonstrations and retrospectives.
* Lead the lifecycle of digital products and pilots, from problem framing and business case through validation, deployment, adoption and continuous improvement.
* Prioritize use cases according to decision value, user value, feasibility, source readiness, risk, scalability and expected efficiency.
* Playing the Role of Data Stewart and proxy Data Owner, define CI&MR data and AI governance standards in coordination with relevant corporate functions.
* Establish together with team governance: common taxonomy, metadata, naming conventions, repository logic, document classification and minimum source-quality requirements.
* Ensure traceability between original evidence, data, analysis, assumptions, AI-generated outputs, recommendations and decision outputs.
* Map research workflows and identify manual activities, delays, duplication and opportunities for standardization or automation.
* Design scalable solutions supporting research intake, data preparation, open-text classification, analysis, insight synthesis, reporting, retrieval and reuse.
* Ensure appropriate Quality Assurance processes rooted on human review, methodological rigor, privacy, confidentiality, security and responsible AI controls throughout the product lifecycle.
* Coordinate pilots and define the conditions for stopping, refining, reusing or scaling each solution.
* Drive user research, testing, onboarding, training, documentation and change-management activities to secure adoption.
* Coordinate the CI&MR Innovation community, enabling cross-region experimentation, best-practice sharing and connection of local pilots to the formal product backlog.
* Act as the primary CI&MR interface with Digital, Data, IT, Cybersecurity, Privacy, Legal, system integrators and technology suppliers.
* Communicate roadmap, progress, risks, dependencies, pilot results and recommendations to leadership and cross-functional stakeholders.
* Stay up to date on AI, generative AI, analytics, automation, knowledge management and market-research technology trends.

**Experience Required**

* Relevant experience in digital product management, product ownership, business analysis, data products, AI-enabled solutions or workflow automation.
* Experience working with agile or iterative product-development teams (better if Scaled Agile Framework, SAFe).
* Experience collecting, structuring and prioritizing requirements from multiple global stakeholders.
* Experience managing a backlog and translating needs into epics, features, user stories and acceptance criteria.
* Experience coordinating cross-functional initiatives and supporting user adoption and organizational change.
* Ability to translate technical concepts into clear user and business value.
* Strong communication, presentation and stakeholder-management skills.
* Flexibility to accommodate global schedules, few regional and international travels.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Business, Engineering, Computer Science, Data Science, Information Systems, Marketing Research, Statistics or a related discipline.
* Fluent in English. Any other language is an added value

**Pay Transparency**
The annual salary for this role is EUR €48,750.00 - €74,750.00 plus any applicable bonus (Actual salaries will vary and will be based on various factors, such as skill, experience and qualification for the role.)
  
  
For roles open across multiple locations, the salary range indicated refers to the primary location. If a different location is considered, the applicable salary range will be communicated to candidates prior to the first interview.

We offer dynamic career opportunities across an international landscape. As an equal opportunity employer, we are committed to delivering value for all our employees and fostering a culture of respect.

job.title: TikTok-Strateg*in und Content-Creator*in @ BÜNDNIS 90/DIE GRÜNEN (Berlin, BE, DE)

#### **Einleitung**

Als Bundesgeschäftsstelle sind wir Servicecenter, Sprachrohr und Ideenschmiede für BÜNDNIS 90/DIE GRÜNEN. Im Mittelpunkt unserer Politik und der Arbeit in der Bundesgeschäftsstelle steht der Mensch in seiner Würde und Freiheit. Das bedeutet Beteiligung, Gestaltung und Erneuerung.
